records.name: React UInputText
records.purpose: Native text input with value-derived filled state, invalid/variant/size/fluid classes, pass-through and unstyled; controlled or uncontrolled.
records.surface: UInputText and UInputTextProps expose a forwarded HTMLInputElement ref plus an inputRef prop; both are merged by an internal setRef (forwardRef callback or object, then inputRef). UInputTextProps extends Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, value|onChange|size> and adds value?:string, onChange?:ChangeEventHandler, invalid, variant:filled|outlined, size:small|large (the visual size, so the native size attribute is reachable only through pt.root), fluid, inputRef, unstyled, pt and ptOptions. The component renders a single native input with type="text" (overridable by the rest props), aria-invalid when invalid, and merges its own props, the rest, the root class and ptm('root') through useMergeProps. p-filled follows the value: for a controlled value it is the value being non-empty, for an uncontrolled input it is state seeded from defaultValue and updated on change. Root classes: u-inputtext u-component, p-filled, p-invalid, p-variant-filled, u-inputtext-fluid, u-inputtext-sm and u-inputtext-lg; variant=outlined has no distinct class, and no disabled class is emitted (the shared CSS styles :disabled). useComponentBase receives componentName inputtext (the Aura registry key), the style module and unstyled, so unstyled drops the Ultimate classes. The style module's CSS is the shared @ultimate/uix-styles/inputtext module (ADR-082). keyfilter, tooltip and validatePattern are not props: useKeyFilter and UTooltip are separate composition (ADR-086, rows 12 to 14 are I). React has no per-instance dt, as PrimeReact. Public runtime and props type are named exports from both @ultimate/react and @ultimate/react/input-text. useComponentBase and createPassThrough from @ultimate/react-core own cx class resolution, style registration and ptm; those are external foundation records, not duplicated here. The manifest advertises dist entry/type paths; this does not prove a built or published package.

records.name: React UInputTextarea
records.purpose: Controlled native textarea with optional auto-resize.
records.surface: UInputTextarea and UInputTextareaProps expose a forwarded HTMLTextAreaElement ref plus inputRef. UInputTextareaProps extends Omit<TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>, value|onChange> and adds value, onChange, invalid, variant:filled|outlined, fluid, autoResize and inputRef. records.name: React UInputMask
records.purpose: Masked text input with buffer-based slot editing.
records.surface: UInputMask, UInputMaskProps and UInputMaskChangeEvent{originalEvent,value,target{name,id,value}}. UInputMaskProps is a closed prop list with no native attribute spread: value:string|null, mask (required), slotChar default _, autoClear default true, unmask default false, onChange(event), onComplete({originalEvent,value}), disabled, readOnly, invalid, variant, fluid, name, id, placeholder, className and inputRef. Consumer onFocus/onBlur/onKeyDown and other native attributes are not accepted. Forwarded HTMLInputElement ref. A buffer/mask algorithm is ported from PrimeReact: definitions 9, a and * plus ? for optional tail; the regex slots are unanchored per-character tests (unanchored). Handlers: onFocus, onBlur, onKeyDown (Backspace/Delete/Escape), onKeyPress (React keypress, deprecated), onInput and onPaste; onChange is also invoked from blur and key handling, not only from typing. A single effect depends on [mask, value] with an eslint-disable comment, so updateValue/initMask are not in the dependency list; the last-required-position ref is not reset when mask changes. Mobile (Android/iOS) branches are excluded. inputMaskStyleModule and the source-only InputMaskClassesParams resolver contract (not a barrel export) reuse --u-inputtext-* variables with fallbacks; the Aura registry has no inputmask module. Exports from @ultimate/react and @ultimate/react/input-mask. useComponentBase from @ultimate/react-core owns cx class resolution and delegates style registration to useComponentStyle; those hooks are external foundation records, not duplicated here. Local style CSS is hand-authored and registered; no scoped style module imports @ultimate/uix-styles. The manifest advertises dist entry/type paths; this does not prove a built or published package.

records.name: React UPassword
records.purpose: Password input with optional strength feedback overlay and visibility toggle.
records.surface: UPassword and UPasswordProps; forwarded HTMLInputElement ref plus inputRef. UPasswordProps extends Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, value|onChange|type|size> and adds value, onChange, feedback default true, toggleMask default false, promptLabel/weakLabel/mediumLabel/strongLabel, mediumRegex, strongRegex, fluid, className, inputRef, onFocus, onBlur. There are no invalid or variant props. className lands on the root div, not the input; the rest spread follows the explicit handlers on the input and can override them. The strength overlay is an inline absolutely-positioned div (no portal) and uses useDisplayOrder and useGlobalEscapeKey with ESCAPE_PRIORITIES.DIALOG from @ultimate/react-core while the overlay is visible and feedback is on. An onKeyUp handler computes strength 0..3 from the regexes. The toggleMask icons are inline SVG role=button with aria-label Show Password/Hide Password and only onClick, with no tabIndex or key handler, so they are not keyboard reachable. passwordStyleModule defines maskIcon, unmaskIcon and clearIcon classes: clearIcon is defined but never used by the component. PasswordClassesParams carries filled, disabled, fluid and strength; unlike input-text and input-textarea, the component does pass filled (value.length > 0) to the root class. Aura key password. Exports from @ultimate/react and @ultimate/react/password. useComponentBase from @ultimate/react-core owns cx class resolution and delegates style registration to useComponentStyle; those hooks are external foundation records, not duplicated here. records.name: React UInputChips
records.purpose: Chip-based multi-value entry with add/remove handling.
records.surface: UInputChips, UInputChipsProps, UInputChipsAddEvent and UInputChipsRemoveEvent{originalEvent,value}. forwardRef<HTMLDivElement>. records.name: React UMention
records.surface: UMention<T>, UMentionProps<T>, UMentionSearchEvent{originalEvent,trigger,query} and UMentionSelectEvent<T>{originalEvent,suggestion}. UMention is a generic function component and not a forwardRef: it accepts no ref. Props: value default empty, onChange(value), suggestions, field, trigger default @, delay default 0, autoHighlight default true, placeholder, disabled, rows default 3, inputId, className, onSearch, onSelect, onFocus, onBlur. The textarea has role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-autocomplete=list and aria-activedescendant but no aria-controls although the list ul carries its own id. The search debounce uses setTimeout with delay and the timer is not cleared on unmount. Enter selects only when a highlight index is set. The overlay is an inline absolute div: no portal and no caret-based positioning. trigger is located with lastIndexOf on the text before the caret. mentionStyleModule is hard-coded CSS without tokens; the Aura registry has no mention key.
